blocks.title: Standard enthalpy change of formation
blocks.text: Kisi compound ki standard enthalpy change of formation, delta Hf, woh enthalpy tabdeeli hai jab compound ka ek mole standard halaat ke tehat apne anasir se bane. Yeh exothermic ya endothermic ho sakti hai.
Methane ke liye, C(s) + 2H2(g) se CH4(g), delta Hf = -74.8 kJ fi mol.

blocks.prompt: C2H4 ki standard enthalpy of formation kaun sa muadla zahir karta hai: 2C(heera) + 2H2 se C2H4, ya 2C(graphite) + 2H2 se C2H4?
blocks.explanation: Graphite wala muadla: formation ki tareef anasir ki standard states se hai, aur carbon ki standard state graphite hai, heera nahi, compound ke ek mole ke banne ke saath.

items: Delta Hf: apni standard states mein anasir se compound ka ek mole; exothermic ya endothermic ho sakti hai (methane -74.8 kJ fi mol).
